enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Fall asleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Continue sleeping. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making a hot drink with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out food items. Close refrigerator. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Cook breakfast. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Pour hot water into mug. Add tea bag. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink tea. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on work shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open work bag. Place laptop into bag. Place stethoscope into bag. Place wallet into bag. Place keys into bag. Zip work bag. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the work shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, caring for patients and attending clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at hospital. Change into scrubs. Attend morning meeting. Review patient charts. Visit patient rooms. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Assist with procedures. Update patient records. Consult with doctors. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend afternoon meeting. Visit more patients. Write reports. Handover to next shift. Change out of scrubs. Leave hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home after the work shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner using the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place pot on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add meat. Stir meat. Add seasoning. Cover pot. Wait for food to cook. Turn off induction cooker. Serve food onto plate.
Sit at table. Pick up fork. Pick up knife. Cut food. Lift food to mouth. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Continue eating. Finish meal. Push plate away. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and cleaning up the kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes. Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Apply dish soap. Scrub dishes. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in drying rack. Wipe counter with sponge. Spray cleaner on counter. Wipe counter again. Rinse sponge. Wring sponge. Put away cleaning supplies.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the living room and vacuuming the floor
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up pillows. Fluff pillows. Place pillows on sofa. Pick up books. Place books on shelf. Pick up trash. Throw trash in bin. Open closet. Take out vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum cleaner. Turn on vacuum cleaner. Vacuum floor. Turn off vacuum cleaner. Unplug vacuum cleaner. Put away vacuum cleaner. Close closet.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up remote control. Turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Lean back. Watch TV. Change channel again. Check phone. Put down phone. Continue watching. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and drying off
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Put on pajamas. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Wind down, checking phone and reading before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check messages. Open social media. Scroll through feed. Put down phone. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off bedside lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket over body.
Lie down. Close eyes. Fall asleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Continue sleeping. Turn to other side. Pull blanket up. Continue sleeping.
